segments.text:
V. 32.
Liſted up from the earth—This is an Hebraiſm which ſignifies Dying. Death in general is all that it uſually imported. But our LORD made Uſe of this Phraſe, rather than others that were equivalent, becauſe it ſo well ſuited the particular Manner of his Death. I will draw all men—Gentiles as well as Jews. And thoſe who follow my Drawings, Satan ſhall not be able to keep.
